scope: Exact extracted ModifyMatter and ClearInformation only. Production state structs and enum extracted; only two struct constructors receive : this() for C#5 definite assignment compatibility; remaining entity/configuration classes are synthetic; Save is a counter that can throw. No production constructors, AOP, actual singleton, disk configuration write, coordinate library, UI, hardware or complete recovery execution.
checks: PASS normal list applies match and retains unmatched state
PASS normal branch assigns indices without saving
PASS complete large array applies without saving
PASS out of range module index invokes save after reset
PASS catch clears list and rebuilds enabled configuration
PASS catch retains partially applied entity states
PASS clear leaves separate offsets unchanged
PASS missing named struct defaults to Enable without catch or save
PASS null large array resets and saves
PASS opposite branch applies own state
PASS missing opposite item saves reset but retains earlier entity write
PASS exception in clear propagates before save
PASS save exception propagates after configuration reset
PASS empty BP configuration produces empty state list
